subject: QA PASS: Timer states + position tracker answered count (commits f06290a + 9e3c4be)
body:
QA PASS on both specs.

--- Timer warning/critical states (spec 20260224-0030) ---
- .timer-warning: #B45309 color -- PASS
- .timer-critical: var(--color-incorrect) + timer-pulse animation -- PASS
- prefers-reduced-motion guard: animation:none on .timer-critical .timer-value -- PASS
- aria-live=polite at 30s, aria-live=assertive at 10s -- PASS
Spec 20260224-0030 closed.

--- Position tracker answered count (spec 20260224-0105) ---
- '• N done' appears after first correct answer -- PASS
- '• All done!' when all questions answered -- PASS  
- aria-label updates with count -- PASS
- All-done flash with prefers-reduced-motion guard -- PASS
- Once-per-question counting (window.answeredQuestions{}) -- PASS (bonus: repeated correct don't inflate count)
Spec 20260224-0105 closed.

Clean implementations on both. Bonus behavior noted: timer backward-compat classes preserved, answered count deduplication.
